svg.aria-label: Simulator quality evaluation: each level exposes one kind of fake
svg.title: Simulator quality evaluation: each level exposes one kind of fake
svg.text: Simulator quality evaluation: each level exposes one kind of fake
Example: an agent builds a kitchen simulation for a robot (a table, a cup, a cabinet with a door). All eight levels ask about it, and each
exposes a fake that the earlier levels cannot catch.
Are the table, cabinet and cup
The cup is missing, or not on
Does it look like the kitchen
Is the cup floating or sunk
into the table? Can the robot
Pull the cabinet door: does it
The door is fixed and will not
Knock the cup off the table:
Tilt the table or make the cup
first here also rank first in
Each level catches a different kind of error; it is not a cumulative score. Most works sit at L0 and L3a; the later levels are
harder to test and have fewer works.
